def fit(self, train_data: Tensor) -> "RadialEmpiricalSource":
        """Fit the radial estimator from training data.

        Args:
            train_data: (n_train, d) — training samples (NEVER mix with val/test)
        """
        r = torch.norm(train_data, dim=-1).cpu()  # (n_train,)
        if self.log_radius:
            r_fit = torch.log(r + 1e-6)
        else:
            r_fit = r
        self._r_train = r_fit

rng_and_sampling.labels: torch.arange(10).repeat_interleave(200), same order for all seeds
rng_and_sampling.original_fixed_initialization: CPU source.sample(n,D).norm(...) followed by separate CUDA torch.randn(n,D) normalized directions; multiply original radii and directions.
rng_and_sampling.paired_gains: An isolated CPU seed-0 call to sample_radii reproduces the original RAFM raw ECDF quantile draws because the source draws radii first.
rng_and_sampling.source_norm_replay: source.sample(...).norm(...) can differ from the raw quantiles by floating-point sphere normalization; record replay differences, use raw quantiles for the intervention.
rng_and_sampling.gain_rng_isolation: Fork and restore the CPU RNG for G; generator sampling has its own restored CPU/CUDA seed-0 RNG scope. No labels, generated directions, test gains, or classifier outputs enter the gain draw.
rng_and_sampling.integrator: Original audio_eval RK4 with tangent-projected vector field, 40 steps, 4 calls per step, no intermediate state renormalization.
rng_and_sampling.intervention: After original fixed-spherical generation finishes, compute X=G*Y/||Y||.
